titles.title: Pelvis with Pedernal

description: The textured, rippling white form of an animal's pelvis bone arches diagonally across the canvas. Beyond the pelvis is an upside down view of Pedernal, deep blue and featureless against a pale blue sky.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
